final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT t.TrackId, m.Name as MediaTypeName, COUNT(*) as group_count FROM PlaylistTrack pt INNER JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId INNER JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY t.TrackId, m.Name), totals AS (SELECT MediaTypeName, SUM(group_count) as total_count FROM grouped GROUP BY MediaTypeName) SELECT g.MediaTypeName, t.total_count, AVG(CAST(g.group_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count) as avg_ratio FROM grouped g JOIN totals t ON g.MediaTypeName = t.MediaTypeName GROUP BY g.MediaTypeName, t.total_count ORDER BY g.MediaTypeName
